metadata.title: Delhi Metro Interchange Line Demand Split Model
metadata.description: Estimates passenger demand distribution across intersecting lines at interchange stations using corridor capacity, ridership volume weighting, and network centrality.
metadata.disclaimer: This is an operational estimate model based on corridor throughput ratios.
